screen.projecthivemind.choose_mode.title: Choose how you play
screen.projecthivemind.choose_mode.subti: This choice is permanent for this world
screen.projecthivemind.hive.title: Hive
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.scout_pi: Pick up dropped items into the hive
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.scout_fl: Run away from hostile mobs (when not selected)
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.scout_no: A selected scout takes what it walks over. One that is not selected goes to items.
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.scout_ar: How far around itself a scout looks for dropped items, and how close a hostile mob has to be before it runs (up to 64).
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.collecto: How far past the edge of the hive area a collector may go to fetch a dropped item (up to 32). 0 keeps collectors inside the hive area.
Collectors always gather items inside the hive area.
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.soldier_: How far around itself a soldier looks. Every option below, except the last, only applies to mobs inside this range.
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.worker_a: How far around itself a worker looks for work (up to 32). It only takes blocks inside this range that the hive can see.
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.dig_thro: Dig toward blocks they can see but cannot walk to
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.worker_n: Only blocks the hive can see, and its tools can harvest.
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.soldiers: Soldiers, when idle and not selected
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.all_in_h: Attack all non-hive mobs in the hive area
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.hostile_: Attack hostile mobs in the hive area
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.unit_are: How far around itself a soldier looks. Every option below, except the last, only applies to mobs inside this range.
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.all_in_u: Attack all non-hive mobs in the unit area
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.hostile_: Attack hostile mobs in the unit area
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.threats: Attack mobs hostile to the hive or its units, anywhere
screen.projecthivemind.quest.title: Quest: reach level %s
screen.projecthivemind.quest.max_level: Your hive has reached its highest level.
message.projecthivemind.no_interactors: Select a worker or a scout for that
message.projecthivemind.cannot_open: That cannot be opened (a scout needs a block with an inventory, not blocked)
message.projecthivemind.cannot_trade: That villager has nothing to trade right now
screen.projecthivemind.weak_tool.title: Tools too weak
screen.projecthivemind.weak_tool.message: None of the hive's tools can collect this block. Your workers can still break it, but it will drop nothing. Dig it anyway?
message.projecthivemind.no_workers: Select workers for that. Only workers can dig or interact
message.projecthivemind.no_soldiers: Select soldiers to attack. Only soldiers can fight
message.projecthivemind.mode_remembered: Game mode %s will apply when you leave the hive
